text:
Aisha: Quick heads up — PR #3421 needs one more style approval before merge. Ran into a formatter exception on a generated proto; I proposed a rename in the service layer. TL;DR: keep generated proto field as `user_id` but expose `UserID` in the service. Thoughts?
Tom: Pinged two reviewers. Do we need an exemption for the formatter or can we patch the generator? Not great to add more exemptions.
Lina: I'd rather avoid changing generator unless necessary. We have precedent of white-listing generated files via .gofumptignore in infra-gen. Example:
```
# .gofumptignore
gen/*.pb.go
```
Aisha: We prefer not to add ignores if possible. The issue is the generator uses snake_case for field names; service wants exported camelCase. Example struct we get:
`type User struct { user_id string `json:"user_id"` }`
Mika: Small nit — exported field should be `UserID`. The json tag can stay `user_id`. Linters won't fail on the tag, they complain about unexported fields if you need them exported.
CI Bot: buildkite: https://buildkite.com/redwood/inference/builds/1234 — gofumpt error in gen/user.pb.go: line 42. Full log: (short) `gofumpt: file changed but not formatted`
Lina: If the generated files include the standard `// Code generated ... DO NOT EDIT.` header we could adjust the hook to skip by header, but our current hook matches paths only.
Aisha: Proposal: revert the rename in generated code (leave `user_id`), add a tiny mapping helper in svc layer to expose `UserID`. That avoids changing generator or hook. Example mapping:
```
func protoToUser(p *pb.User) User {
  return User{UserID: p.GetUserId()}
}
```
Mika: :thumbsup: Good compromise.
Tom: I'll re-run CI after that commit. Can you push the mapping and revert, Aisha?
Aisha: On it. Also adding a one-line comment in the PR description explaining why we keep generator naming and where the mapping lives.
Tom: @Lina @Mika — can you give final ok after CI green?
Lina: I'll do a quick pass after CI.
Mika: Will review after the mapping commit. If it matches the pattern we used in userservice, I'm fine to approve.
Aisha: Thanks — back to code, will ping when green.
